72 (cont.) When a ray of light travels from air (a rarer medium) to glass (a denser medium), it bends
(A) away from the normal (B) towards the normal (C) parallel to the normal (D) none of these

73. Which one of the following is the natural source of oxalic acid?
(A) Tomato (B) Tamarind (C) Orange (D) Vinegar

74. Propane, with the molecular formula C3H8 has
(A) 7 covalent bonds (B) 8 covalent bonds (C) 9 covalent bonds (D) 10 covalent bonds

notes: This page has Q72's English continuation at top, plus full bilingual Q73 and Q74. Pen-mark: Q73 option (A) has a small tick mark (wrong — correct is B, tamarind/imli, a well-known natural source of oxalic acid). No marks on Q74.
